problem: Find all of the subsets of $S={r,t}.$
worked_solution:
To find every subset of $S,$ we list out every combination of elements within $S.$

We can use the following diagram to visualize the process:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14070456/assets/022399e6a7a5e1f79b58e856aa8e9e5e9f3561e8e4bcb5b80a95237d30d06002.png)

Note that we must include the empty set since it is a subset of every set.

By doing this, we get

$$
∅,{r},{t},{r,t}.
$$
